generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of newborn visit (新生儿探访). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Create a quiet daytime newborn visit in a serene bedroom, photographed from seated adult eye level. One sleeping newborn lies safely on its back in the bassinet, wrapped in the swaddle blanket with face unobstructed. A visitor places one gift hamper on a bench rather than reaching over the baby. Arrange the booties, folded muslin cloth and nursing cushion separately nearby; put the baby monitor and night light on different surfaces. Display one simple handprint keepsake frame without any written name or date. Gentle window light, warm neutral palette, anatomically correct baby and adult hands, no cot clutter or duplicate gifts.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: newborn baby, bassinet, swaddle blanket, baby gift hamper, knitted baby booties, muslin cloth, nursing cushion, baby monitor, keepsake handprint frame, soft night light.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
